title: C: String Builder
description: Build an efficient string builder that dynamically grows as strings are appended.

steps.title: String Builder
steps.description: Define a `StrBuilder` struct with a char* buffer, length, and capacity. Implement `void sb_init(StrBuilder *sb)`, `void sb_append(StrBuilder *sb, char *s)`, and `void sb_free(StrBuilder *sb)`. Append 'Hello', ' ', 'World' and print the result.
hints: Start with capacity 16, double when full.
